2608.10628.title: InSight-doc: Agentic Visual Perception for Long-Document Understanding
2608.10628.paper_summary: Long-document understanding often requires reasoning over many visually rich pages, making inference costly and prone to context rot. In this work, we propose InSight-doc, an agentic visual perception framework that treats visual resolution as an adaptive reasoning-time resource. InSight-doc starts from low resolution and selectively zooms into high-resolution regions for finer evidence, without relying on any external retriever. To train such an agent, we construct an active-perception corpus of 17.9K high-quality SFT examples with region-level zoom-in trajectories, accompanied by 19.2K hard RL examples. Through SFT+RL, InSight-doc-8B improves the baseline by 4.3--16.4 accuracy points over document VQA benchmarks. On long documents, it reduces hallucination by more than 40% and inference latency by 41%--68% while maintaining an accuracy lead. Our code, datasets, and model are released at https://github.com/m-Just/InSight-doc .
2608.10628.paper_summary_zh: 長文件理解通常需要在許多視覺豐富的頁面上進行推理，這使得推斷成本高且容易出現上下文衰退。在這項工作中，我們提出了 InSight-doc，一個代理視覺感知框架，將視覺解析度視為一種自適應推理時間資源。InSight-doc 從低解析度開始，並選擇性地放大到高解析度區域以獲取更精細的證據，而不依賴任何外部檢索器。為了訓練這樣的代理，我們構建了一個包含 17.9K 高品質 SFT 範例的主動感知語料庫，帶有區域級的放大軌跡，並附有 19.2K 難度較高的 RL 範例。通過 SFT+RL，InSight-doc-8B 在文檔 VQA 基準上將基線提高了 4.3--16.4 個準確度點。在長文件上，它將幻覺減少了超過 40%，推理延遲減少了 41%--68%，同時保持了準確度的優勢。我們的代碼、數據集和模型已在 https://github.com/m-Just/InSight-doc 上發布。
